status: Authored, unreviewed. One decision per catalog technique with confirmed or demonstrated evidence: where it acts on a device, or why it is not placed. Techniques with weaker evidence are not mapped yet. These decisions are this tool's own analysis and need expert review. Each placement also names how the technique gets in: through the device's own systems, at the neural interface, or through what the patient sees and hears.

QIF-T0001.basis: Delivers current through the device's own stimulation path.

QIF-T0003.basis: Intercepts recordings where they travel between components.

QIF-T0004.basis: Sits between two components and alters or relays what passes.

QIF-T0007.basis: Alters protocol messages to or from the neural interface.

QIF-T0016.basis: Backdoors the decoder model where it is trained.

QIF-T0017.basis: Backdoors a decoder model where it is hosted or as it is delivered.

QIF-T0018.basis: Tampers with the signal filter chain before decoding.

QIF-T0019.basis: Feeds a decoder inputs crafted to be misclassified.

QIF-T0024.basis: Poisons the data a decoder model is trained on.

QIF-T0029.basis: Floods the stimulation path the device controls.

QIF-T0035.basis: Presents stimuli and reads the evoked response, so it needs a display path and cortical recording.

QIF-T0041.basis: Infers identity or traits from recordings where they are processed or stored.

QIF-T0042.basis: Observes radio emissions of a wireless link.

QIF-T0043.basis: Enters through firmware or its delivery path.

QIF-T0044.basis: Attacks the back-end service and its network path.

QIF-T0045.basis: Captures encrypted recordings now for later decryption.

QIF-T0048.basis: Tampers with the electrodes physically. For an implant this means surgical or supply-chain access.

QIF-T0049.basis: Defeats authentication on a radio link.

QIF-T0050.basis: Glitches hardware an attacker can physically hold.

QIF-T0051.basis: Exposes recordings where they are stored or in transit.

QIF-T0052.basis: Harvests evoked responses, so it needs a display path and cortical recording.

QIF-T0053.basis: Captures decoded cognitive state where recordings are classified.

QIF-T0057.basis: Maps the device's reachable network connections.

QIF-T0058.basis: Corrupts calibration where it is performed or stored.

QIF-T0067.basis: Replays or synthesises neural activity patterns through the stimulation path.

QIF-T0091.basis: Identifies and tracks a device by its Bluetooth radio characteristics.

QIF-T0103.basis: Hijacks visually evoked responses through display flicker. Applies where the device uses visual evoked potentials.

QIF-T0175.basis: Runs attacker code on whichever component opens the recording or study file, so it needs a component that parses neural or clinical data rather than a path to tissue.
